provider.githubToken: Fine-grained personal access token with read-only "Contents" permission.
provider.gitlabToken: Project or group access token with the read_repository scope.
provider.bitbucketToken: Repository, project or workspace access token with the "repository" (read) scope.

admin.title: SpecPage settings
admin.intro: Control where API specs can load from and whether readers can send test requests.
admin.allowUrlsHelp: Page editors can load specs from https:// URLs on the spec hosts you approve below.
admin.allowTryItOutHelp: Signed-in users can send test requests to the API hosts you approve below. Guests and anonymous visitors never can.
admin.cacheFor: Cache specs from Git and URLs for
admin.cacheHelp: Attachments are never cached because access depends on the reader's page permissions.
admin.cacheCleared: Cache cleared. Pages will reload specs from their sources.
admin.gitIntro: Connect GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket so pages always show the latest spec. Use read-only tokens scoped to the repos you list.
admin.deleteConfirm: Delete the connection "{name}"? Macros that use it will stop loading.
admin.connectionSavedNotApproved: Connection saved, but {host} wasn't approved, so pages can't load from it yet. {reason}
admin.name: Name
admin.authBearerBitbucket: Repository, project or workspace access token (Bearer)
admin.authBasicBitbucket: API token with Atlassian account email (Basic)
admin.tokenHelpSuffix: Stored encrypted in Forge secret storage and never sent back to the browser.
admin.tokenKeep: Leave empty to keep the current token.
admin.reposHelp: One per line, e.g. {hint} or a wildcard like acme/*. Page editors can only use these.
admin.spacesHelp: Comma-separated space keys. Empty means all spaces.
admin.hostsIntro: SpecPage can only contact hosts you approve here. Atlassian asks you to confirm each change, and you can review or revoke them any time in Atlassian Administration > Connected apps.
admin.hostInvalid: Enter an https host like api.example.com or a wildcard like *.example.com.
admin.hostLimit: Each list holds up to {max} hosts. Remove one first or use a wildcard like *.example.com.
admin.activityIntro: Recent changes to SpecPage settings, connections and approved hosts, newest first.
